title: Disappointing! Not as expected
text:
Disappointing! Not as expected. I like OXO products, but, for the first time, I am disappointed in an OXO product. (1) If you look at the bottom of the chopper, you will see that the transparent cup fits into a black rubber seal that also serves as the base of the chopper. I have noticed that some commenters have written that this seal or gasket can be removed, but, if so, my hands are not strong enough to remove it. I can't get it off at all and previously assumed (before reading the comments) that it was permanently affixed to the transparent cup. The seal comes-up about 1/8" to form the base. I discovered that chopped bits of food were wedged down between the seal and sides of the transparent cup. These will not rinse out. If your hands are not strong enough to remove the seal (if it can be removed), you will have to figure-out a way to remove the trapped food either with a slender kitchen utensil or with your fingernail. (Sorry, I know it's gross!) I don't know whether or not I received a particularly badly made chopper or whether this is a design flaw. NOTE: See UPDATE below. (2) It takes a good amount of effort and time to chop the food. Even though the transparent cup shows that it will hold 1 cup, in reality you can only chop about 1/4 cup and then will need to empty the transparent cup. If you don't, the chopping blade does not have enough vertical space to operate well. It will take a fair amount of force to chop manually, so this gift is not ideal for a senior or anyone with limited mobility.

Like all OXO products, it is well made and seems sturdy. The blade did a good job of chopping the vegetables. As one commenter noted, however, you will have to chop the vegetables into small chunks to fit them inside the small transparent cup.

I plan to use the chopper (if I don't toss it) for celery, shallots, and similar kinds of items.

I have never owned a chopper before and so can't comment about this chopper in comparison to similar products. I do like the OXO brand, however, and was surprised to discover that this item has been disappointing.

UPDATE: Since writing the comment above, I discovered that the base with black rubber seal is easy to remove if I run it under very hot water and then punch the base lightly to push it out of the transparent cup. « Show Less

description: OXO Good Grips Chopper,White/BlackQuickly and safely cut fruits, vegetables, nuts and more with the OXO Good Grips Chopper. Use the Chopper directly on your favorite cutting board or with the included easy-measure cup. Simply place your ingredients inside the cup and press down on the non-slip knob to chop. A tab rotates inside the container to keep food from sticking to the sidewalls, while the built-in bumper absorbs shock and reduces noise. Scoop out chopped ingredients with the included spoon, or snap the lid on to save for later. The wave-pattern blade cartridge easily unscrews for quick cleanup, and the knob locks in closed position for simple storage. BPA-free. Removable blade is dishwasher safe.OXO Good Grips Vegetable and Onion Chopper with Easy Pour OpeningNo more tears! Quickly and safely chop onions, peppers, and more in one easy motion, and easily pour chopped fruits or veggies without removing the lid.
